archetypes.name: fd-routing
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds quiet-mode fd routing and contract-stream fallback behavior that can silently break orchestration if mishandled.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Python quiet-mode and contract-stream changes, especially fd 1/2/3/4 duplication, inherited quiet environment handling, broken pipe fallback, and where breadcrumbs land. Check whether result JSON can be lost, duplicated, routed to quiet logs instead of the caller, or emitted after stdout has been redirected. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: state-kv
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes shell-style state quoting and unquoting across Python and shell handoff files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review finalize-state and ship-pr-state read/write compatibility across Python and shell scripts. Focus on quoted versus unquoted legacy values, boolean normalization, multiline rejection, shlex parsing edge cases, and preservation of stall metadata during restore and teardown. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ship-cutover
archetypes.rationale: The diff broadens the Python ship driver cutover surface and updates orchestrator documentation around Step 8+ re-entry.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the Python ship driver, implement Skill prose, and recovery scripts still agree on Step 8+ control flow. Pay attention to which keys come from stdout JSON, finalize-state.sh, ship-pr-state.sh, and session-env.sh, plus whether PHASE, OOS_PENDING, and stall recovery are scoped consistently. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-globs
archetypes.rationale: The plan specifically warns against broad dynamic Codex globs that could leak prompts or telemetry into committed run logs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the round artifact allowlist and tests for Dynamic Codex and static Codex transcript handling. Focus on whether glob ordering and pattern breadth can include prompt-shaped files, vote prompts, events telemetry, diagnostics, or other unintended sidecars despite the documented exclusions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pr-base
archetypes.rationale: The diff threads a base branch into PR creation, which affects repo workflow behavior beyond unit tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the PR creation path changes that pass an explicit base branch through the Python driver. Check whether existing PR reuse, fork/draft/local-only paths, push recovery, and gh wrapper expectations remain compatible when base is provided or absent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
